items.title: Fred Moore Interview, 1959-06-19
items.q: Tells Benbow I bust a drum head. How much a drum head cost? During that time it cost, but it cost a dollar and a half then. So he gave me a dollar and a half.

ctx.x: What about New Orleans? You told me you made a trip down there. I went to New Orleans.

I'm, see, I can't remember the year. And I'm moving so fast. I got up to the sides. I went to New Orleans and, uh, William Benbow. He was another old producer. He had a bad age. Put your money in there. Yeah. He make the money, but he didn't want to pay the, pay the musician, the performance. But I, he don't owe me around about, he owed me around about three weeks. He would've owed me more, but I got a hip, a hip to myself. Always busting drum heads. I wouldn't bust no drum heads. I make turn I bust it. After the…
